description: Legal scholar Ülle Madise was elected on Wednesday to lead Estonia, with support from part of the parliamentary opposition. This result underscores the strength of Estonian democracy as Moscow aggressively steps up efforts to portray the former Soviet-occupied country's independence as illegitimate.

headline: French financial prosecutor calls for trial in Polynesian branch of 'Qatargate'
description: According to information obtained by Le Monde, the national financial prosecutor's office has recommended that four individuals stand trial, including former Tahitian FIFA official Reynald Temarii and Qatari billionaire Mohamed bin Hammam, in connection with the controversial awarding of the 2022 football World Cup to Qatar.

headline: Leaked Spanish report  claims 'total permissiveness' of Morocco over Ceuta crisis
description: A leaked report alleges some Moroccan police officers guided crossings into the Spanish enclave, undermining Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's insistance Rabat did not orchestrate the crisis.

headline: War in Ukraine: Constant air raid alerts unsettle daily life in Kyiv
description: Since late August, sirens have sounded in the Ukrainian capital at an unprecedented rate not seen since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022. This new reality has upended routines the city's 3.7 million residents.

headline: Sweden, a 'paradise' for the ultra-rich, debates billionaire tax ahead of elections
description: Regarded as one of the most egalitarian countries in the world, the number of billionaires in Sweden has continued to rise while poverty has increased. Ahead of the September 13 elections, taxing the wealthiest has become a major campaign issue.
